periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis of the visible eye patch is oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle downward toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid blob with a longitudinal axis approximately 1.6 times the width of its transverse axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct tapering at the anterior-inferior margin, creating a teardrop effect pointing toward the snout.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curvature on the posterior boundary of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Wide band covering approximately 40% of the visible torso area from the nape to the mid-back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant separation between the dark ear regions, approximately equivalent to the width of the frontal cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded, semi-circular curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Atypical brown pigmentation in all pelage regions that are traditionally black in this species (ears, eye patches, and dorsal band).
